_comment: Exemptions for tools/secret_scan.py. Every entry is a VERIFIED false positive with a written reason (25+ characters); never exempt a real secret. `secret_scan.py --tracked` (CI and drift invariant 21) fails on an entry whose pattern_id is unknown, whose path is not tracked, or that no longer exempts any match in its file; commit-message entries are checked for pattern id and reason only. commit_policy_boundary is the full SHA of the newest commit whose message the current message rules refuse: it and its ancestors were checked under the rules in force when they landed (some carry session trailers or review ids) and are not re-checked, because history is not rewritten; the CI backstop checks the commits after it. A change that widens a message rule runs `python3 tools/secret_scan.py --commit-messages <boundary>..HEAD` before it merges, and moves the boundary in the same change when an older commit fails the wider rule. An entry pins the exact text it exempts as match_sha256 (the sha256 printed beside each finding), so it never exempts a later, different match of the same pattern in the same file; an entry with no pin exempts nothing.
